text:
sam: Heads up — scheduling deploy for feature/latency-fixes to prod at 2026-04-02 22:00 UTC (deploy window). Owners: @sam, @maya, @eli. Need quick signoff + smoke owners. Rolling deploy, canary 5% for 10m. Ping when ready.

maya: I can own smoke tests (+metrics). I'll run the perf smoke once canary is up. ETA 22:05 UTC.

eli: I'll watch rollout and rollback readiness. I've staged the fallback model variant (v2-quant-fallback).

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @sam: 2026-04-02T22:00:00Z — Canary 5% for 10m — Auto-notify: ops-oncall

sam: Checklist (quick):
- [x] Release branch merged
- [x] CI green
- [ ] DB migration: none
- [x] Canary image uploaded
- [ ] Post-deploy smoke owner assigned -> @maya
- [x] Rollback plan drafted

maya: Smoke plan:
1) Verify 200 on /health and /v1/infer
2) Run load check for 30s: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}"` -> expect 200
3) Check p95 latency < 300ms in APM
I'll paste commands below.

maya: ```
# canary endpoint
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
ab -n 100 -c 10 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# sample inference
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test", "max_tokens":5}'
```

eli: Rollback steps:
1) Toggle canary off in console -> fallback to stable
2) Pin route to previous model sha `model@sha:abc123`
3) If persistent, rollback infra with `./scripts/rollback.sh prod <timestamp>`

ops-oncall: I'll be on watch during the window. If alerts spike, tag `#incidents` and I'll jump in. Pager is on.

sam: Quick approvals: @maya ok? @eli ok? If both green I'll start the deploy at :22:00:00Z :shipit: 

maya: :thumbsup: got it, will post smoke results in this thread.

eli: Ack. I'll hold the rollback command ready and watch traces.

sam: Starting canary now (5%). I'll post canary link. If no major regressions after 10m we'll ramp to 50% then 100%.

deploy-bot: Canary started by @sam — instances: 4 canary pods. Monitoring: perf, errors, token-cost. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/1898765432

maya: Canary GET /health -> 200
Sample inference -> 200
p95 ~ 220ms
No errors in logs so far.

eli: Traces look ok. CPU on canary nodes at 45%.

ops-oncall: Alerts: none. Observability looks clear.

sam: Ramping to 50% now. If any of you see issues call it out immediately. Rolling window set to 10m.

maya: 50% smoke: p95 @ 260ms, rates steady. continuing to monitor.

eli: I see a small spike in token cost for a subset — digging. If it's >15% we revert.

maya: No functional regressions, ready for 100% in 5m.

sam: Ramped to 100%. Thanks everyone. Post-deploy: monitor for 30m. Closing thread after that.
